reviews.title: An unforgettable escape
reviews.body: From the moment we arrived, every detail was thoughtful — the forest view from the soaking tub, the complimentary herbal tea ritual, the hand-written welcome card. We left feeling restored and already planning our return.

reviews.title: Worth every baht
reviews.body: Stayed for our anniversary. The staff arranged rose petals and a small cake without us even asking. The bed was heavenly and the morning light through the balcony doors was unreal.
Lovely room with greenery everywhere. Breakfast was excellent. Slightly noisy air-conditioning on the second night but the staff sorted it quickly when we called.

reviews.title: A perfect honeymoon
reviews.body: The villa exceeded every expectation. Private pool, outdoor rain shower, the staff's warmth — everything was picture-perfect.

reviews.title: Stunning ocean view
reviews.body: Waking up to the ocean horizon was magical. Bathroom a little tight for two but the bed and view more than made up for it.

reviews.title: Disappointing checkout experience
reviews.body: Room itself was nice but checkout took 40 minutes because of a billing dispute. Would consider returning only with guaranteed late-checkout option.
